This is the higher-risk of the two candidates here; the 'custom' candidate below tests the rotation-allowed interpretation instead so Tier 2 can settle which is actually right.

Same backtracking, but each tile may also be placed ROTATED 90 degrees (as a th x tw rectangle) when its dimensions differ -- tests the alternative reading of the ambiguous rotation question above.
